(Japanese: '''嫌われたアブソル''' ''The Detested Absol'') is the 64th episode of ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]'', and the 1,149th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on April 30, 2021, in the United Kingdom on September 22, 2021, in Canada on September 25, 2021, in South Africa on November 23, 2021, and in the United States on January 21, 2022. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== Ash and Goh return to Hoenn to help their friend Hodge, who explains that Lavaridge Town’s hot springs have dried up. Hodge’s uncle suspects it’s Absol’s fault, but Ash and Goh know that’s just a superstition. When they climb Mt. Chimney to investigate, they find the landscape has been frozen! It turns out some Glalie have been protecting a Snorunt by covering everything with ice, and Absol’s only been trying to warn everyone before the trapped steam causes an eruption! With Absol’s help, our heroes manage to safely release the steam and restore the hot springs, and Absol is so grateful, it decides to become Goh’s newest Pokémon! ==Plot== At the [[Cerise Laboratory]], {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] inform [[Professor Cerise]] that they've received a research request from [[Hodge]], a {{pkmn|Trainer}} whom they [[JN007|befriended]] during the [[Battle Frontier Flute Cup]]. His uncle's hot springs had dried out, and soon after, an {{p|Absol}} had been spotted nearby. Some of the townspeople, including Hodge's uncle, believe the old superstition about Absol being a bringer of disasters, and thus are blaming it for causing the incident. As such, Ash and Goh are now intending to figure out the true cause behind the situation. Understanding their point, Professor Cerise dispatches his two [[Professor's assistant|research fellows]] to help Hodge out. Ash and Goh travel to [[Lavaridge Town]] in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]], where they meet up with Hodge. They notice that the local shops are closed, as all the tourists have disappeared after the hot springs dried out. Hodge brings Ash and Goh to an old stone tablet depicting Absol in the midst of multiple disasters, saying that his ancestors left it there to warn people of the supposed dangers that Absol posed. One event carved on the stone depicts the hot springs drying out, explaining why people are blaming Absol for causing it now too. Hodge brings Ash and Goh to his uncle's inn, where they find him and a group of townspeople preparing to hunt down and capture Absol. Hodge introduces his friends to his uncle, who doesn't seem to believe they can do anything to help. Ash and Goh protest that what they're planning to do to Absol is wrong, and manage to convince Hodge's uncle into giving them two hours to figure out the true cause behind everything before they head out to hunt for Absol. The investigation begins at the dried-out hot springs. Hodge says that everything started about half a month ago when his uncle spotted Absol on the mountain, after which the water had cooled down and then stopped flowing altogether. Goh reads from his [[Rotom Phone]] that Lavaridge Town's hot springs originate from [[Mt. Chimney]]. Hodge confirms this, saying that ever since Absol showed up, no one has dared to check the source spring up on the mountain out of fear of running into the [[Pokémon category|Disaster Pokémon]]. Ash and Goh decide to check it out, while Hodge tries to convince his uncle to give up on his hunting idea. Ash and Goh start climbing up the mountain road, but as they approach their destination, they suddenly find their path blocked by Absol, who starts attacking them. While they avoid being hit by its attacks, said attacks knock over several trees and block off the road, forcing the two Trainers to search for an alternate route. They do so, soon locating the pipes that pump water down the mountain, and follow it to the spring, where they find the area covered in snow and ice. Goh wonders how the water could've frozen, as hot spring water is heated up by underground magma before it surfaces and thus shouldn't be able to freeze despite the cold. Goh calls out his {{TP|Goh|Trapinch}} and has it use {{m|Dig}} to investigate underground. Trapinch does so but quickly resurfaces, shuddering from the cold. As Goh [[recall]]s Trapinch, he notices that even the earth dug up by it is frozen, meaning that something is definitely wrong. Suddenly, a cold wind blows past the two, and they notice a {{p|Glalie}} approaching them. It attacks them, and although {{AP|Pikachu}} manages to block its {{m|Ice Shard}} with {{m|Electroweb}}, its {{m|Blizzard}} forces them to seek shelter. Goh stops Ash from attacking back, suggesting they follow Glalie as it leaves, as it and its possible friends could be the reason behind the ground freezing. They do so, stealthily following Glalie to a cave, where it reunites with two other Glalie and a {{p|Snorunt}}. Goh theorizes that they froze up the mountain, as it's too hot for them to live on otherwise. Ash suggests that dealing with the Glalie should solve their problem, but before Goh can even attempt to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} them, Absol suddenly shows up and drives them back, allowing the Glalie to get away before running off itself. Ash wonders if Absol is trying to tell them something, and Goh decides to make a phone call to Hodge. Goh informs Hodge of what he and Ash have found out and asks him to check out the stone tablet for anything that's currently happening, which he agrees to. As they climb up the mountain, Goh explains to Ash that if the stone carvings depict events that Absol tried to warn people about earlier, maybe they could figure out what's going on. Just then, Hodge calls back and says that he spotted a drawing of hot springs freezing on the stone tablet, as well as an image of the volcano erupting. Using this information and his Rotom Phone, Goh is able to figure out what's going on: 300 years earlier, Glalie wandered up the mountain and the hot springs froze, after which all the ice melted at once, resulting in a {{wp|phreatic eruption}}. The same is happening now, which is why Absol stopped them from catching the Glalie. Just then, they notice a jet of steam venting out from the mountainside, a sign that the eruption is imminent. They rush up the mountain and see a large boulder blocking a hot spring. Goh figures that they can prevent the eruption by breaking the boulder and letting the steam vent out. He calls out his {{TP|Goh|Cinderace}} and has it attack the boulder with {{m|Pyro Ball}}, but it has no effect. Pikachu's {{m|Thunderbolt}} proves equally ineffective, and the second round of attacks doesn't help much. However, Absol then appears and attacks the boulder as well, managing to crack it. The three Pokémon keep attacking the boulder, cracking it more and more. However, time is running out, so Absol, out of desperation, rams into the boulder, causing it to finally shatter completely. A jet of superheated water erupts out, and Goh flings a {{i|Poké Ball}} at Absol to save it. The Ball hits and catches Absol, saving it from being hurt by the eruption. Cinderace cools the Poké Ball down and passes it to Goh, who lets Absol out. With the eruption averted, Goh thanks Absol for its warning and tells it it's free to go. {{TP|Goh|Absol}}, however, instead pushes its Poké Ball out of Goh's hand and goes back inside it, showing that it wants to stay with him, making Goh happy. Back in Lavaridge Town, Ash, Goh, and Hodge now get to bathe in the newly rejuvenated hot springs. Hodge thanks Ash and Goh for their help and says that they'll take the Glalie, who are bathing in a vat of ice water next to them, to someplace colder, as Mt. Chimney isn't a suitable place for them anyway. Hodge's uncle, meanwhile, is sorry for having blamed Absol for the incident and expresses his apology by dumping some ice-cold water from the Glalie's bath onto himself. He quickly joins the others in the hot spring to recover from the cold, and they enjoy a comfortable bath together until the time comes for Ash and Goh to return to [[Vermilion City]]. ==Major events== * {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] visit [[Hoenn]] and meet up with [[Hodge]] again. * [[Goh's Trapinch]] is revealed to know {{m|Dig}}. * Goh {{pkmn2|caught|catches}} an {{TP|Goh|Absol}}. * Goh tries to {{pkmn2|released|release}} Absol, but it chooses to stay with him. {{animeevents|JN}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * [[Goh's Absol]] ==Characters== ===Humans=== [[File:Dare da JN064.png|thumb|200px|{{tt|Dare da?|Who's That Pokémon?}}]] * {{Ash}} * [[Goh]] * [[Professor Cerise]] * [[Ren]] * [[Chrysa]] * [[Hodge]] * Hodge's uncle * Townspeople ===Pokémon=== [[File:WTP JN064.png|thumb|200px|Who's That Pokémon?]] [[Who's That Pokémon?]]: {{p|Absol}} * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Cinderace}} ({{OP|Goh|Cinderace}}) * {{p|Trapinch}} ({{OP|Goh|Trapinch}}) * {{p|Grookey}} ({{OP|Goh|Grookey}}) * {{p|Absol}} ({{OP|Goh|Absol}}; new) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Professor Cerise]]'s; [[Rotom Phone]]) * {{p|Hariyama}} ([[Hodge]]'s) * {{p|Glalie}} (×3) * {{p|Snorunt}} * {{p|Absol}} (×3; picture) ==Trivia== [[File:JN064 AS.png|150px|thumb|The "[[After the Story]]" artwork for this episode]] * [[Get Inspired!
